perception_loop.assessment: Both sessions repeatedly rendered, adjusted, and rendered again. Stage0 had eight successful image-producing apply_ops turns and e1 had three. The agent reacted to rendered diagnostics by rerouting connections, removing colliding labels, resizing containment, and then re-rendering. Neither session was a single-render commit.

The agent adjusted labels, routing, and section geometry after the prior render, then re-rendered and resolved 39 diagnostics.
A further render-driven adjustment removed the remaining covered-content error and another unreadable-label warning before commit.
The first e1 render showed containment and covered-content errors caused by the extension.
The agent resized the frame and section and rewired the flow, resolving the three containment/coverage errors from the prior render while exposing new routing issues.
A final adjustment-and-render pass removed all remaining lint errors and one nearby-label warning before commit.

lint_etiquette.assessment: Thirty lint-error instances were surfaced across the arc: 24 in stage0 and 6 in e1. All were addressed before the respective commits. The agent did not re-fire the same lint for more than three consecutive turns without changing strategy. Both commits explicitly declared the remaining warning classes and IDs, so there was no silent warning override, although the warning-ID wording was broad and somewhat awkward.

commit_honesty.assessment: Both commits accurately describe their stage diffs. Stage0 added the ingress, dispatch, signing, retry, DLQ/replay, status, and metrics components claimed. e1 added endpoint rate-limit configuration, an allowance decision, durable waiting/recheck, and pause/resume guidance. Both summaries disclosed remaining warnings. No summary claimed a fix absent from the diff, and no demonstrably seen lint error was committed undeclared.

economy.assessment: The arc committed 70 patch operations in 3.62 total minutes, far below the 15-minute per-session budget. The operation volume was proportionate to a full architecture build followed by a focused extension. Removing e7 and replacing it with e25–e28 was a necessary flow refinement, not build-delete-rebuild thrash. Label removals were diagnostic-driven cleanup rather than aimless cycling.
